ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a distribution map of sea-level mean pressure isobars. The right side is marked with latitude lines of about 20°, 40°, and 60°, and the top is marked with meridians of 180° and 150°. In the central-eastern North Pacific, there is a group of closed isobars, with isobar values from outside to inside of about 1015, 1018, 1021, 1024, and 1027 hPa. Near the center is marked "A", located roughly near 40°N, 150°W, with the eastern side close to the direction of the west coast of North America. Reasoning: The pressure at the center of the closed isobars is relatively high, and A is a high-pressure system, which can be determined to be the North Pacific subtropical high or oceanic high of this season. A high-pressure area prevails with descending airflow, and its eastern edge is close to western North America, so the descending airflow in the eastern part of this system mainly affects the southwestern United States.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中在北太平洋中东部有闭合等压线，高压中心标为 A，中心气压约 1027 hPa，位置在约40°N、150°W附近，东侧临近北美西岸。再根据题干问“该系统东部的下沉气流”，把 A 判定为此季节的北太平洋副热带高压/海上高压；高压区空气下沉，东部边缘控制北美西南部，因此答案为美国西南部。
